source: BBOC 2025 Mountain West Betting Preview Part 1+2 (Mike Calabrese/Collin Wilson/Josh 'Duck' Nunn; Stuckey on the Pac-2)

teams.key_avoids: Double-digit favorite in every MWC game; the traps are non-con at USF (wk1 — 'upset alert', went to the Dirty South and nearly lost at Georgia Southern last year) and at Notre Dame. Hosts App State off a bye.
teams.bboc_notes: The clear MWC favorite — nobody pays the win-total tax; the actionable bet is the conference future at -140 (a better money-line ticket than the title game). 9th in returning production (rare for G5). Replacing Ashton Jeanty in the aggregate (Sire Gaines, Breezy Dunbar the athletic freak, Malik Sherrod from Fresno) — Colin notes Gaines' tiny sample doesn't match Jeanty's missed-tackle rate. QB Maddux Madsen: 21:3 TD:INT looks great but only 7 BTT/13 TWP and 50th in on-target — and now every eye is on him with Jeanty gone. Biggest drop-off is at OC (Nate Potter, unproven, replaces the departed play-caller). D blitzed to a nation-leading 55 sacks but was 131st allowing 30+ pass plays (Schneider tackling 132nd); top-5 tacklers back (LB Jayden Virgin-Morgan). Colin/Duck: take the ML vs Notre Dame over the +190 playoff number.

teams.key_avoids: DODGES San Jose State in conference play (a big bonus + possible back-to-back byes to open October). Idaho State in wk0, then UCLA, at Miami-OH, at Boise; Air Force in a tricky spot after altitude at Wyoming. Three byes by Oct 25 (great for juggling QBs).
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Mike UNDER 8.5 (marquee-hire variance, priced too close to last year's 11-win team), Colin/Duck see ~8-4 and are fine (Colin bets UNLV -13.5 wk1 vs Sam Houston off a WKU beatdown). New HC Dan Mullen (elite offensive schemer, poor recruiter — could be a stepping stone) + NFL DC Paul Guenther. Only 2 returning starters (129th ret prod); lost Hajj Malik Williams (an underrated dual-threat engine), LB Jackson Woodard, S Jalen Catalon, and the DC. QB battle: Alex Orji (elite runner, can't throw — Michigan wouldn't let him) vs Anthony Colandrea (deep-ball boom/bust, 28 BTT/27 TWP). RB Jai'Den Thomas heated up late; OL replaces everyone (was 10th in line yards). Mike leans under; high variance.

teams.key_avoids: The EASIEST path to the MWC title game — AVOIDS Boise, Colorado State AND UNLV. Texas in wk2 (don't need to win it). Conf road games are the bottom rung (Wyoming, Utah State, Nevada, San Diego State); back-to-back elevation at Wyoming + Utah State the only worry.
teams.bboc_notes: The title sleeper — Duck OVER 7.5, Colin's actionable play is +220 to MAKE the title game (a 2-unit play, since they dodge Boise/UNLV and can't lose a head-to-head tiebreaker). Ken Niumatalolo proved he can change stripes (Navy option → spread-and-shred). 63rd in returning production. Lost Nick Nash + Lockhart, but Walker Eget's 17:8 BTT:TWP shows it wasn't ALL Nash; WR Danny Scudero (Sac State) + P4 additions; 32 OL starts back incl a full-time blindside tackle; 7th-fastest offense (quick game mitigates the line). Defense projects top-3 MWC at all three levels (LB Jordan Pollard, 115 tackles). Cakiest schedule in the league — the whole bull case.

teams.key_avoids: Schedule flips much tougher than 2024 — at Washington, UTSA + Wazzu no gimmes, at San Diego State, then at Boise on back-to-back travel weeks before hosting Air Force in the finale (the triple option eats them up late).
teams.bboc_notes: All UNDER 6.5 (-155) — Colin projects 5.5 (and hasn't taken an under on Norvell since he arrived). Identity confusion: the pass-happy Norvell offense went run-heavy in 2024 (injury-forced, after Tory Horton got hurt) and reportedly wants to open it back up — but QB Brayden Fowler-Nicolosi looked awful vs quality secondaries (12.4 / 44.6 QBR vs Colorado and Miami-OH), the OL was 100th in line yards and returns two starters, and there's no proven explosive WR (Armani Winfield 1.4 YPRR). New DC Tyson Summers (takeaway king) + edges Jax Evans + Mukendi Wa-Kalonji could be a good pass-rush duo, but the secondary is all-new. 2024 was fool's-gold (soft schedule); this one is a landmine. Fade lean.

teams.key_avoids: Tough non-con at Kansas + at Oregon State (road trips) plus Georgia Southern wk1 (Colin's play — elite CB vs JC French). The gift: THREE MWC home games off byes (Nevada, San Diego State, Wyoming, Oct-Nov). Road games (at San Jose State, at Boise, at CSU, Hawaii) are the doubt.
teams.bboc_notes: Both lean OVER 6.5 (-130) — Colin projects exactly 7 (untriggered, half-win from projection), Duck is high on them. Home-run hire in Matt Entz (North Dakota State) with OC Josh Davis (South Dakota) + DC Nick Benedetto (from NIU, a top situational D — 27% 3rd-down). Power football: heavy 12/13 personnel, RBs Elijah Gilliam + Bryson Donaldson (1,000 yds/11 TD returning), a matchup-nightmare 4-deep TE room — mucks games up, cashes unders. 116th in returning production. QB EJ Warner cut his TWP rate every year (4.7%→3.5%); no clear go-to WR. Keeping shutdown CB Aziah Hamilton (13 PBU, 7th nationally) out of the portal was huge vs the pass-heavy slate. Colin over 6.5, hedge on the island (at Hawaii Sept 20).

teams.qb_status: Battle — Josh Johnson (light on in-game experience)
teams.key_avoids: Bucknell + Utah State early (an extended preseason for a new QB). Losses baked in at Boise, at UNLV, at San Jose State; a Navy/Army split is doable; UConn on Nov 15 is Duck's red-ink FADE spot (a meaningless out-of-conference trip). Hawaii + Wyoming come to altitude.
teams.bboc_notes: All lean OVER 5.5 (Colin projects 6.5, though he'd want a 6 not -170) — the value of a veteran staff + non-transferring roster (2024's 1-7 start flipped to a strong finish once the OL woke up between the Army loss and the Fresno win). Triple option with FB Dylan Carson + versatile Cade Harris; OL returns 3 full-time starters (all seniors) + Ban Gura back from Minnesota. New QB Josh Johnson has been in the system 3 years (Scout/2nd team) — if he's even a B-minus, they bowl. DC Brian Knorr's D stayed top-50 in scoring / 27th vs the pass even when hung out to dry; the whole trench is back (seniors), but the secondary is green. Duck: 6-6 is the floor; a team that doesn't quit.

teams.key_avoids: NO Boise on the schedule. But road-heavy and brutal — plays half the schedule by Sept 27 (six straight to start), with road trips to Arizona, Air Force (altitude), Colorado State (altitude), San Jose State, UNLV. Timmy Chang is 2-15 away from the island. Ends hosting Wyoming (a 3am ET bowl-or-bust sweat).
teams.bboc_notes: BIG HOST SPLIT — Mike loves them (over 5.5, a bowl team, best offense Chang can field), while Colin (projects 4.6, under 5.5) and Duck (under 6.5) hammer the 2-15 road record and Timmy Chang's overall struggles. QB Micah Alejado went nuclear vs a historically-bad New Mexico D (small sample) — Duck won't crown him yet. WRs Pofele Ashlock, Nick Cenacle, + 4-star Stanford transfer Jackson Harris (a possible Nash-type); the full secondary returns (Verdell Edwards) and the 'Lions Den' LBs have experience; DT Luther McCoy (Minnesota) the key vs power. 61st in returning production. It's a regular-season-win HOOK (over 5.5 / under 6.5) hinging on the road performances.

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Jayden Denegal (Michigan) / Bert Emmanuel Jr (Central Michigan)
teams.key_avoids: Winnable Stony Brook early; could pluck Cal or Wazzu; at NIU (descending) winnable; hosts Colorado State + Wyoming; Nevada + New Mexico on the slate. After Stony Brook, Colin sees no game they're favored by 6+.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Duck OVER (bet over 4.5; a 6-6 bowl team on year-2 of the as-tech-fast system + the most returning defensive production in the G5, 10 starters), while Colin PASSES at 4.4 (fast totals may go too high, likes their overs, but no favorite-by-6 after wk1). 14th in returning production. Arguably the worst MWC QB play in 2024 (Duffy/O'Neil) — now Jayden Denegal (Michigan) + electric Bert Emmanuel Jr (CMU) run an offense that NEEDS an athletic QB; RB Christian Washington a serviceable replacement for Marquez Cooper. The D returns 10 starters incl edge Trey White (13 sacks) but was awful last year — DC Rich Aurich (from Idaho) is the change. Denegal/Emmanuel are the fun late-night watch.

teams.key_avoids: Three wins on the schedule (Akron, Northern Iowa, Nevada) then coin-flip city; last six games include a road trip to end at Hawaii. Severely outclassed at Utah, at Colorado, UNLV, San Jose State home. Duck likes them situationally vs Colorado (sandwich) + hosting SJSU (Laramie wind).
teams.bboc_notes: Fade lean — Mike UNDER 5.5 (fool's-gold alert; after the first two wins he sees no four more), Colin passes (projects 5.7 but hates the team), Duck has two situational plays but no win-total lean. The Craig Bohl magic is gone: 90th in scoring D / 103rd total, only 11 turnovers forced, and DC Aaron Bohl was retained (no scheme rescue). QB Kaden Anderson's numbers are skewed by New Mexico (5 of 8 BTT came in that one game); the lone weapon is TE John Michael Gyllenborg (you must run to open him up), and the OL was 124th in line yards despite 4 returning starters. Two-deep secondary is void of experience (one returning PBU). Under 5.5 / under 4.5 on alts.

teams.key_avoids: UTEP (wk1, Colin's play — Utah State -156), Air Force, Hawaii all in the first six weeks (varied attacks/tempos to prep for). At Texas A&M; at New Mexico (Bronco's return to UNM). Fade spot hosting Air Force off a Texas A&M beating.
teams.bboc_notes: Year-zero rebuild — all three pass the win total (Colin ~5, can't get over 3.5; Mike + Duck see overs until totals inflate, 4-8). Bronco Mendenhall is back in his territory (this is his ground to collect transfers) and long-term this works, but 2025 is a mess: 124th in returning production. They're trying to recreate the Devin Dampier magic with mobile QB Bryson Barnes (BYU, 559 rush yds but a rising 4.5% TWP rate) — RB Miles Davis (BYU) a track star; new OC (SJSU WR coach) brings quick-passing principles at ultra-fast tempo. But the OL returns ONE starter and the defense returns ONE — and the puzzling move was importing DC Nick Howell + five defenders from New Mexico's terrible unit. Overs team by circumstance.

teams.key_avoids: A team that started 3-4 (6-1 ATS) then lost six straight in 2024 — blown out by Colorado State, Hawaii, UNLV late. Duck was 'convinced' this was a 3.5 win total.
teams.bboc_notes: A FADE / official under — Duck bet under 4.5 (his first regular-season-win wager of the summer; he'd have gone under even at 3.5 with plus money). 132nd in returning production. QB Brendon Lewis departs, Chubba Purdy comes in (Duck never impressed anywhere he's been). The OL is a full rebuild (Andrew Madrigal the lone holdover) after struggling to protect in 2024; the outperforming defense is ALSO a full rebuild at all three levels (the big physical SMU-opener secondary is gone), was 5.1 YPC vs the run with only 14 sacks/54 TFL. And they were wildly undisciplined — 99 penalties / 935 yards, which directly cost them games (coaching). Resembles the late-2024 team that got blown out, not the feisty early one.

teams.key_avoids: Third head coach in three years. At Michigan (Duck faded), at UCLA, Boise, at Air Force in the first six weeks; the winnable-ish games are Idaho State, New Mexico State, Utah State, Nevada.
teams.bboc_notes: Year-zero fade — under 3.5 only (Mike can't touch 220-1; Duck under, faded wk1 at Michigan, eyeing under 2.5 conf wins). 135th in returning production (of 136). Gone is the electric Devin Dampier (to Utah, with his OC Jason Beck); new HC Jason Eck + OC Luke Schleisner (Idaho) deploy a slow, methodical, run-heavy attack (2:1 run:pass) behind RB Scott 'Trey' Humphrey (Montana State) — but the OL was a bottom-10 unit masked entirely by Dampier's escapability, and Jack Lane isn't nearly as mobile, so a really weak D (only Gabe Lopez back up front; secondary allowed 65% comp, 30 pass TD, 3 INT) will get exposed. An overs team until totals get out of control (last year's Utah State game closed 87.5 and soared over). LB Jackson Eck (the coach's son) a decent player.
